keep_playing_why: B has a skill ceiling I can see: drift angle and speed, combos, near-miss clips and smash chains, with a clean line an expert would take. I wanted to go back and learn it. A has a good multiplier and bloomstorm loop, but most of my time was a slow walk across a big grey map and a boss fight I could not read.
better_made_why: B reads as finished from the first frame: strong lighting that changes from golden hour to night to rain, big chain text, a magnet rescue that always puts you back on the road, and a start screen that explains the controls. A also looks good with its ink-to-colour effect, but its aim and objective guidance were confusing, and nothing told me what was killing me at the inkwell.
furthest_A: Olive Terraces, still on the first objective 'Break the inkwell'. Never broke the inkwell. Score 88,940, x5 multiplier peak, 1.8% restored. Saw NODES OPEN once and 'THE INK TOOK YOU' once (one death seen clearly).
furthest_B: Yozakura Pass, Easy. Reached in-game 01:47 at night and rain (dawn at 06:00 not reached), 45 mi, score 11,793, combo only ever x1.
